links.outcome: Readability grade level of AI-generated leaflets versus professionally authored leaflets
links.effect: RCS England leaflets had Flesch-Kincaid Grade Levels 5.52-7.15 and Flesch Reading Ease above 70; AI leaflets often had Grade Levels above 12, with Gunning Fog and SMOG indicating post-secondary reading requirements.
links.quote: In contrast, AI-generated leaflets frequently exceeded recommended complexity thresholds, with Grade Levels often above 12 and Gunning Fog and SMOG scores indicating post-secondary reading requirements.

links.outcome: Comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education materials by readability metrics
links.effect: AI-generated leaflets did not consistently meet recommended readability standards; ChatGPT most complex, Gemini and DeepSeek intermediate but still suboptimal.
links.quote: While LLMs offer promising avenues for scalable health communication, current AI-generated PILs do not consistently meet recommended readability standards.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability scores of LLM-generated patient leaflets compared to professional leaflets without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
